info.name: MASAR API
info.description:
Clean, professional Postman collection for the MASAR backend, built directly from `routes/auth.php`, `routes/users.php`, `routes/api.php`, and the actual controllers/validators.

Base URL variable: `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost/Masar/backend`).

## Suggested flow
1. **00 - Environment / Setup -> Health Check** to confirm the backend is reachable.
2. **01 - Authentication**: Register, then Login. Login captures `access_token`, `user_id`, `user_role`, `csrf_token` and the HttpOnly `refresh_token` cookie automatically.
3. **02 - Users**: authenticated account endpoints (Bearer token + CSRF header handled by pre-request scripts).
4. **03 - Auth & Users Security Tests**: run after the happy-path requests to verify error handling.

## Test credentials
All credentials are safe development placeholders (`@test.local`). Set them to accounts that actually exist in your environment (for example the seeded dev accounts `admin@masar.test / Admin@123456`, `student@masar.test / Student@123456`, `company@masar.test / Company@123456`) before running the Login requests.

## Authentication notes
- Protected endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`.
- Token refresh uses the server-issued HttpOnly `refresh_token` cookie (path `/api/v1/auth`) plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header, which must match the `csrf_token` cookie. The collection attaches the CSRF header automatically from the cookie jar.
- CSRF-protected write endpoints (`PUT /users/me`, `DELETE /users/me`, `POST /auth/refresh`) require a prior successful Login so the CSRF cookie exists.
- There is currently no routed email-verification endpoint in the backend, so it is intentionally omitted.
- reCAPTCHA is disabled in the local `.env` (`RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false`), so `recaptcha_token` is not required. If enabled, add it to the register/login/reset bodies.

item.name: Google OAuth

request.description: Public. Generates a Google authorization URL. The backend creates a single-use server-side state (expires in 600s) and embeds it in the URL. The test stores the returned URL and extracts `state` into `google_state`. Open the URL in a real browser to obtain the authorization `code`.

Public. Exchanges the Google authorization code for a session. Requires a real `code` (obtained by opening the authorization URL from the Start request in a browser) and the matching single-use `state`. The backend validates and consumes the state server-side, then redirects to the frontend. Redirect following is disabled so the redirect is visible. If the Google email has no account, one is auto-created as a student and a welcome email is sent.

item.description: Student APIs: profile lifecycle, skills, CV/files, training applications, certificates and notifications. Run '01 - Authentication -> Login (Student)' first so `access_token` is captured. Academic request bodies use the seeded names (e.g. Cairo University / Faculty of Computers and Artificial Intelligence / Artificial Intelligence / Bachelor of Computer Science). The 'CV / Files' subfolder must run before 'Complete Student Profile' so the `cv_file_id` collection variable exists (the upload request sets it automatically). Set `training_id` before using the Applications subfolder.
